description: Labelled point file of Centres of Population placenames from the National Gazetteer dataset. This dataset is provided by Tailte Éireann

links.title: Centres of Population - National Placenames Gazetteer
ArcGIS FeatureServer Centres of Population - National Placenames Gazetteer (live Tailte Éireann service)

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry in WGS 84 (OGC:CRS84) after conversion; the service stores it in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157). The only column declared as geometry.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID_1
table:columns.description: Second internal row number carried over from an earlier version of the layer; not stable across data versions.

table:columns.name: County
table:columns.description: County the placename lies in, in English.

table:columns.name: Contae
table:columns.description: County the placename lies in, in Irish.

table:columns.name: Local_Gove
table:columns.description: Local government area the placename lies in, in English (truncated field name for Local_Government_Area).

table:columns.name: Limistéar
table:columns.description: Local government area the placename lies in, in Irish (truncated field name).

table:columns.name: Classifica
table:columns.description: Classification of the placename in the gazetteer, in English (truncated field name for Classification).

table:columns.name: Cineál
table:columns.description: Classification of the placename in Irish.

table:columns.name: Gaeltacht
table:columns.description: Marks whether the placename lies within a Gaeltacht area.

table:columns.name: Town_Class
table:columns.description: Settlement class of the placename, where the gazetteer records one.

table:columns.name: ID
table:columns.description: Gazetteer identifier of the placename record.

table:columns.name: English_Na
table:columns.description: Placename in English (truncated field name for English_Name).

table:columns.name: Irish_Name
table:columns.description: Placename in Irish.

table:columns.name: Foirm_Ghin
table:columns.description: Genitive form of the Irish placename (truncated field name for Foirm Ghinideach).

table:columns.name: Alternativ
table:columns.description: Alternative form of the placename recorded by the gazetteer (truncated field name).

table:columns.name: IG_E
table:columns.description: Easting of the point in the Irish Grid (EPSG:29903), in metres.

table:columns.name: IG_N
table:columns.description: Northing of the point in the Irish Grid (EPSG:29903), in metres.

table:columns.name: ITM_E
table:columns.description: Easting of the point in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157), in metres.

table:columns.name: ITM_N
table:columns.description: Northing of the point in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157), in metres.

table:columns.name: Irish_Vali
table:columns.description: Validation status of the Irish form of the placename (truncated field name).

table:columns.name: Legislatio
table:columns.description: Legislation under which the Irish form was declared, where applicable (truncated field name for Legislation).

table:columns.name: Validated_
table:columns.description: Whether and how the placename has been validated by the Placenames Branch (truncated field name).

table:columns.name: Date_
table:columns.description: Date recorded against the gazetteer entry.

table:columns.name: Comment_
table:columns.description: Free-text comment recorded against the gazetteer entry.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry as a struct of xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, added by the GeoParquet conversion.

providers.name: Tailte Éireann
providers.description: Tailte Éireann, the State agency for national mapping, land registration and property valuation established under the Tailte Éireann Act 2022 and successor to Ordnance Survey Ireland (OSi). Publisher of the National Statutory Boundaries, the national placenames gazetteer and the 250k mapping series as open data. Source read 2026-09-20.
